ui.about_lead: Igitabo c'ikirere kidasaba interineti, ariko gishobora kuronka amakuru y'ubu igihe bisavywe. Ibisanzwe vy'ikirere vy'isi yose birimwo muri porogaramu kandi birasomwa nta interineti; uko ikirere kimeze ubu, iteganyagihe, integabwirizi n'amashusho araronderwa gusa igihe ubisavye.

ui.about_privacy: Utumenyetso twawe tw'urugo n'urufunguzo rwa OpenWeatherMap birabikwa gusa muri uyu mushakisha kandi ntibirungikwa ahandi na hamwe. Porogaramu itangura nta interineti na hamwe; irungika amakuru gusa ku bijanye n'amakuru y'ubu wasavye, irungika gusa aho ahantu hakenewe.
ui.about_foot: Weatherglass — ni ku busa kandi igashaka kubanza gukora nta interineti. Buri soma rigaragaza igihe caryo; igihe nta interineti, ibisanzwe birimwo muri porogaramu birakomeza gukoreshwa.

ui.disc_body:
Weatherglass ni igikoresho c'amakuru, ntabwo ari serivisi y'umutekano. Amakuru y'ikirere, iteganyagihe, imigereka ya kahise n'integabwirizi za nyabuzima biraronderwa ku masoko atari uwacu (Open-Meteo, MET Norway, US National Weather Service, ibigo vy'ikirere vy'ibihugu, GDACS, na OpenWeatherMap igihe wongeyeko urufunguzo rwawe bwite). Birashobora gutinda, kutuzuye, kuba bitari vyo, canke kutaboneka, kandi Weatherglass ishobora kubisoma nabi canke kutabigaragaza.

Ntukoreshe iyi porogaramu mu gufata ingingo zijanye n'ubuzima, amagara, ivyo utunze canke umutekano wo kugenda — harimwo n'ivyuho, umwuzure, indege, ubwato, ubugendo canke akazi ko hanze. Buri gihe kurikiza ibigo vy'ikirere by'aho uri n'amabwirizwa y'umutekano rusangi; integabwirizi zabo ziruta ikintu cose kigaragara ng'aha.

Igitabo c'ikirere kidasaba interineti kigaragaza impuzandengo z'igihe kirekire (1991–2020) n'inyandiko za kahise. Kirasobanura uko ikirere kimera bisanzwe, si ukuntu ikirere kizoba umusi runaka.

Ahantu uri harakoreshwa gusa igihe ubikanze kugira ubukoreshe, kugira ubone ikirere c'ako kanya, kandi ntitubika na rimwe. Utumenyetso twawe tw'urugo n'amagenamiterere birabikwa kuri iki gikoresho gusa.

Weatherglass itangwa ku busa, “uko imeze”, nta cemezo na kimwe. Ku rugero rwemejwe n'amategeko, uwayanditse ntiyakwishura igihombo canke akaga kavuye mu gukoresha canke kwizigira ivyo irimwo.

Mu gukanda kuri Ndabitahuye kandi ndemeye, uremeza ko wasomye iyi ntumbero. Izosubira kugaragara inyuma ya buri vugururwa.
